red_metadata_store.pro


Routines

top source red_metadata_store

SST pipeline

red_metadata_store, metadata [, fname=string] [, /force]

Store metadata in a fits header-only file.

Parameters

metadata in type=structarr

An array of structs containing metadata in the form {keyword, value, comment}.

Keywords

fname in optional type=string default=info/metadata.fits

The name of the file in which to store the metadata.

force in optional type=boolean

Set this to overwrite existing metadata with the specified keyword.
